data.title: It’s almost impossible to sell a condo unit these days: ‘I feel trapped’
data.summary_raw: Selling a condominium unit has become a challenge for many, as buyers get spooked at the prospect of bearing ever-rising HOA fees — even if the home comes with a lower price tag.
